parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of trans presentation or documented police sweeps, but if outed a visitor faces state-tolerated bias violence with no hate-crime or public-accommodation protection, no recorded discrimination convictions, and official exclusion framed as protecting 'biological women.' The decisive tier-1 exposure is birth-sex prison placement: a 2020 report documents men’s-prison placement facilitating sexual assault, with no identity-based policy, unit, or court remedy documented. Documents showing birth sex/name create identity-check mismatch scrutiny, though the dossier does not document border refusal of foreign passports. Current legislative hostility (2021-2025 censorship/education bills, 2025 anti-LGBTIQ meeting) reinforces this. No trans-specific violence rate or post-1997 fatal case is documented, so magnitude is uncertain and not inferred; the 2020 custody harm and tolerated impunity support a rating below the 0.45 custody-only profile.
